caseNameFull: Texaco Inc. v. Dagher and Shell Oil Co. v. Dagher

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of Washington Legal Foundation, Visa U. S. A. Inc. et al., Chamber of Commerce of the United States of America et al., and Antitrust Scholars for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 369 F. 3d 1108.
